The business is carried out by consolidated subsidiaries Kitayama Shoji Co., Ltd., Ryuichi Shoji Co., Ltd. and Eishin Shoji Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥24,509 million.
